prompt:
Create one high-fidelity desktop website first-viewport comp, 16:9, approximately 1440×810, for the real homepage of World Champion Taekwondo Washougal. The art direction is “Certificate Clearing”: Vienna Secession page grammar fused structurally with a taekwondo school, never Polish folk flowers and never decorative costume. Show an unmistakable browser website viewport with a crisp horizontal header across the top: at left a modest circular school mark (clearly a brand mark, not an award seal) beside the words “WCT Washougal”; at right a clean navigation reading “About   Programs   Schedule   Instructors   Contact” and a restrained text link or compact action. Use an ivory uncoated-stock ground with subtle paper fiber, deep blue #274E73 and vivid red #E70E1B. From all four outer page margins, grow disciplined inward trim derived only from dobok V-collar angles, belt-line bands, taekwondo stance vectors, and taegeuk-like interlocking geometry. The border should feel architectural, flat, rectilinear, premium, and screen-designed: broad blue edge fields, fine red counter-lines, corner geometry, precise asymmetry, no flowers, no vines, no folklore, no gold, no carnival, no medal motifs, no fake seals, no fake awards. Keep a generous calm center clearing, as if the geometry respectfully steps back to make space for the teacher and message.

Inside the center clearing, compose a modern conversion-focused hero that still reads immediately as a website rather than a diploma or poster. Place a small but unmistakable documentary-style color photograph of diverse elementary-age kids in clean white doboks practicing a confident taekwondo front stance in a bright, real-feeling school; respectful and natural, no competition spectacle, no confetti, no trophies. Let the kids remain identifiable as the school audience, but keep the photo secondary and compact, perhaps a vertical crop anchored near the left edge of the clearing with one controlled overlap into the geometric trim. Next to it, set the exact large headline: “Learn from Master Chulan Kim.” Use a distinctive, authoritative display type with crisp Secession-era geometric proportions, not a generic luxury diploma script. Beneath it, make these exact credential lines the important supporting text, highly legible and typographically deliberate: “7th Degree WTF” / “Yong-In University” / “National Champion 1995”. Do not add or imply any other credentials, awards, rankings, claims, prices, testimonials, badges, or statistics. Add one strong rectangular red primary CTA labeled exactly “Request information”, with a precise blue keyline or small directional notch derived from dobok collar geometry. Include a quiet short line such as “World Champion Taekwondo Washougal” only if needed for website clarity; avoid extra marketing copy.

Visual hierarchy: functioning website header first, large headline second, credential lines and CTA next, small kids-in-stance photo as proof and identification, ornamental trim framing rather than competing. High-end editorial web design, realistic typography, production-ready spacing, sharp UI details, no rounded-card dashboard language, no giant full-bleed stock photo, no gradients, no glassmorphism, no diploma border, no ceremonial certificate layout. The center is bright and open while the all-margin geometry creates a memorable perimeter system. Render as a polished browser-page comp only, straight-on, no device mockup, no hands, no desk scene.
